content_sections.heading: About HNBGU
content_sections.text: Hemvati Nandan Bahuguna Garhwal University is a Central University at Srinagar (Garhwal), Uttarakhand. The notice is issued by the Dean of its School of Engineering and Technology, whose letterhead gives the address as School of Engineering and Technology, HNB Garhwal (A Central) University, Srinagar, Uttarakhand, India-246174. The Guest Faculty will serve the Electronics and Communication Engineering programme of this School.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice invites applications for one Guest Faculty in a single department. It does not give a category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification or the experience required. The notice invites applications from "interested and eligible" candidates without listing the eligibility conditions. The prescribed application form attached to the notice asks applicants to fill in the following details, which indicates what the department will look at: Academic record from school-level examinations onwards, with year, subject, name of the board/university, total marks, marks obtained and division/class. Rows for Bachelor's Degree, Master's Degree, M.Phil/Equivalent and Ph.D., with the title of the thesis and whether the Ph.D. was awarded as per the UGC Regulations 2009. NET/SLET/SET or an equivalent examination passed (UGC/CSIR/any other). Teaching experience at undergraduate level, postgraduate level and post-doctoral level, and research experience, each in years and months, plus other experience, if any. Publications. These are entries in the form, not eligibility conditions printed by the notice. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The engagement is for the services of part-time/temporary guest teachers (anshkalik/asthai atithi shikshak) for the session 2026-27 only. The application form describes it as the "engagement of Guest Faculty for the session 2026-27". The pay, honorarium or any allowance is not specified in the notice. The notice also does not mention working hours, the number of lectures or any extension beyond the session. According to the declaration in the application form, the candidature or engagement may be cancelled if any information is found false or if ineligibility is detected before or after the engagement.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for HNBGU Guest Faculty
content_sections.text: Applications are made only through the prescribed format attached to the notice. The notice allows two ways to submit it, with the same deadline of 5 PM on 18 November 2026: Fill in the prescribed application form given with the notice (name, department/course/centre, date of birth, category, correspondence address and email, contact numbers, qualifications, experience and publications). Sign the declaration and the form; the form states that an application not signed by the candidate is liable to be rejected. Either submit the filled form in the department, at the School of Engineering and Technology, HNB Garhwal (A Central) University, Srinagar, Uttarakhand, India-246174. Or send the filled form to the department's email address: [email protected] . Make sure the application reaches the department by 5 PM on 18 November 2026. The notice does not mention any interview, written test or shortlisting method, and does not name the documents to be attached.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Use only the prescribed application form (nirdharit praroop) attached to the notice. The periods of teaching and research experience claimed in the form must not overlap. An application not signed by the candidate is liable to be rejected. Candidature or engagement may be cancelled if any information is found false or ineligibility is detected before or after engagement.
